cave-entrance.name: Volcanic Cave Entrance
cave-entrance.description: The heat rises as you step deeper into the cavern. Lava flows glow in the distance.

lava-chamber.name: Lava Chamber
lava-chamber.description: A massive chamber with a bubbling pool of molten lava. The rogue Fire Mage stands on a central platform.

ice-spell.name: Ice Spell Scroll
ice-spell.description: A scroll containing a freezing ice spell, the perfect counter to a fire mage.

fire-tome.name: Book of Elements
fire-tome.description: The stolen magical tome glowing with hot, volatile elemental power.

hero.name: Alden
hero.description: A young hero seeking to save the kingdom.

fire-mage.name: Ignis the Fire Mage
fire-mage.description: A rogue fire mage who stole the Book of Elements to freeze the outer world.

dialogues.before_talk: Ignis: Intruder! You think you can stop me? I will reduce you to ashes!
dialogues.after_talk: Ignis: Out of my sight, fool! Prepare to burn!
dialogues.hostile: Ignis: Aagh! The cold! It freezes my flames!
